target_customer: Developers and teams running coding or business AI agents that want lower token bills
problem: Running many agents is expensive in tokens, and deploying agents to production needs sandboxes, sessions and logs.
business_model: Usage-based router and agent deployment; no markup initially, BYOK supported
product_category: LLM routing and agent deployment infrastructure

founders.name: Avyay Varadarajan
education: Caltech, computer science (per YC page, described as previously studying)
founders.background_notes: YC page also mentions startups, not named.

founders.name: Benjamin Hong
founders.background_notes: No background on the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Training custom routing models and running per-session sandboxes is standard ML and infrastructure work with some hard parts.

defensibility.rationale: Routing and agent hosting are offered by gateways and labs; a two-person team has little structural advantage.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not stated; several routers and gateways exist and no action against dari.dev found.

market_need_then: Token costs for agent workloads were a visible pain in 2025; the company pitches cost reduction while keeping performance.

branding.domain_note: Uses dari.dev. A separate YC company named Dari uses usedari.com, and an unrelated Dari AI exists.

brand_strength.rationale: Little brand material found; name collides with other Dari companies.

pivots.from: Browser automation agent (earlier launch post, per YC page)

outcome_analysis: Active as of 2026-11 and too early to judge. The company moved from a browser agent to a routing and deployment layer, in a space with many gateways, so differentiation and distribution are the open questions.
notes: Funding unverified: YesPress claims a $4.3M seed led by YC in May 2026 and VCBacked a $500K pre-seed (Dec 2025) possibly for a different Dari; neither is primary.
